name: io.github.cyanheads/eurostat-mcp-server
description: Search and query the Eurostat catalogue — EU economy, demography, trade, and NUTS regional data.

environmentVariables.name: EUROSTAT_CLAMP_LIMITS
environmentVariables.description: Clamp positive integer preview/search/dimension limits to 500/100/1000 with a notice. False restores schemas rejecting over-cap inputs.

environmentVariables.name: MCP_LOG_LEVEL
environmentVariables.description: Sets the minimum log level for output (e.g., 'debug', 'info', 'warn').

environmentVariables.name: EUROSTAT_BASE_URL
environmentVariables.description: Eurostat API base URL. Override when using a mirror or proxy.

environmentVariables.name: EUROSTAT_COMEXT_BASE_URL
environmentVariables.description: Base URL of the Comext dissemination host, which serves every DS-* dataset code (detailed trade and PRODCOM). Override when using a mirror or proxy.

environmentVariables.name: EUROSTAT_REQUEST_TIMEOUT_MS
environmentVariables.description: Total allowance for one Eurostat request across retries, backoff and body consumption, in milliseconds.

environmentVariables.name: EUROSTAT_METADATA_TIMEOUT_MS
environmentVariables.description: Total allowance for one dataset's SDMX dataflow structure across retries, backoff and body consumption, in milliseconds. Defaults to 120000; separate from EUROSTAT_REQUEST_TIMEOUT_MS for large structures.

environmentVariables.name: EUROSTAT_TOC_CACHE_TTL_MS
environmentVariables.description: How long a fetched catalogue TOC stays usable before the next catalogue call refreshes it, in milliseconds. Defaults to 12 hours.

environmentVariables.name: EUROSTAT_BULK_TIMEOUT_MS
environmentVariables.description: Total allowance for one eurostat_download_dataset transfer across request retries, backoff and streaming body consumption, in milliseconds. Defaults to 120000.

environmentVariables.name: EUROSTAT_BULK_MAX_BYTES
environmentVariables.description: Byte budget for one eurostat_download_dataset transfer, counted on the decoded TSV rather than on the wire. Eurostat sends the body chunked with no Content-Length, so the budget is enforced while streaming and the transfer is aborted when it is reached. Defaults to 50 MiB.

environmentVariables.name: CANVAS_PROVIDER_TYPE
environmentVariables.description: Dataframe canvas backend. The default, 'duckdb', lists eurostat_dataframe_describe and eurostat_dataframe_query, stages query matches with stage=true or above 5,000 observations, and retains bulk downloads beyond their previews. Set to 'none' to disable the canvas and those tools. The DuckDB binding ships with the server.

environmentVariables.name: CANVAS_TEMP_PATH
environmentVariables.description: Parent directory for DuckDB canvas spill files: a private 'mcp-canvas-XXXXXX' directory is created inside it, so it must be writable by the server process. Defaults to the OS temp directory.

environmentVariables.name: CANVAS_TTL_MS
environmentVariables.description: Sliding lifetime of a staged dataframe canvas in milliseconds; every call against it extends the window. Defaults to 24 hours.

environmentVariables.name: CANVAS_DEFAULT_ROW_LIMIT
environmentVariables.description: Maximum complete rows a single eurostat_dataframe_query returns before reporting truncated.

environmentVariables.name: EUROSTAT_DATAFRAME_DROP_ENABLED
environmentVariables.description: Set to 'true' to list eurostat_dataframe_drop, which removes one staged table from a dataframe canvas and leaves its other tables in place. Off by default because a drop cannot be undone; staged tables expire with their canvas either way. Has no effect with CANVAS_PROVIDER_TYPE=none.

environmentVariables.name: MCP_TRANSPORT_TYPE
environmentVariables.description: Selects the HTTP transport.

environmentVariables.name: EUROSTAT_CLAMP_LIMITS
environmentVariables.description: Clamp positive integer preview/search/dimension limits to 500/100/1000 with a notice. False restores schemas rejecting over-cap inputs.

environmentVariables.name: MCP_HTTP_HOST
environmentVariables.description: The hostname for the HTTP server.

environmentVariables.name: MCP_HTTP_PORT
environmentVariables.description: The port to run the HTTP server on.

environmentVariables.name: MCP_HTTP_ENDPOINT_PATH
environmentVariables.description: The endpoint path for the MCP server.

environmentVariables.name: MCP_PUBLIC_URL
environmentVariables.description: Public origin override for deployments behind a TLS-terminating reverse proxy (e.g. https://mcp.example.com).

environmentVariables.name: MCP_AUTH_MODE
environmentVariables.description: Authentication mode to use: 'none', 'jwt', or 'oauth'.

environmentVariables.description: Sets the minimum log level for output (e.g., 'debug', 'info', 'warn').
